method: manual CAD-to-machine placement, set by hand in service_2020's viewer against variant v1 (the master helmet)
notes: Fixed, one-time registration of the CAD model to UFRAME2 machine coordinates. Used by pipeline/contour_fit.py as the optimizer's starting pose (R0, t0) for every variant, not recomputed per run. Only needs a new dated folder here if the CAD model or its machine-frame registration is redone from scratch.
